dossier.summary: Foxglove Dental Partners runs nine dental practices in the Pacific Northwest. Each practice hires its own hygienists and front-desk staff.

data.title: Staffing a practice group without agencies

data.why_you: This session was planned with practice groups like Foxglove in mind: nine locations that each hire their own hygienists and front-desk staff. The main talk covers how another group shares one hiring bench across its sites.
